headline.text: Houthis fire missiles at Riyadh after Yemen port strikes
headline.context: Saudi Arabia says all three were intercepted.
headline.vo: Saudi Arabia says it shot down three ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh early on Saturday. Yemen's Houthi rebels launched them after Saudi-led air strikes on Yemen.

beats.text: *Three missiles* aimed at the Saudi capital
beats.vo: The Saudi-led coalition said all three missiles were destroyed. It is the second Houthi attack on the Saudi capital in a few days.

beats.title: How it escalated
beats.vo: Yemen's war flared up again in July, alongside the US-led war with Iran. Earlier this week, a Houthi attack damaged Riyadh's tallest skyscraper. On Friday, the coalition struck Hodeidah port, saying it was used to smuggle weapons. Hours later, the missiles were fired at Riyadh.

beats.quote: Saudi airspace is unsafe, as it will be the theatre of our operations in the coming hours.
beats.vo: The Houthis told airlines to treat Saudi airspace as unsafe, and threatened Saudi ports on the Red Sea. The United Nations says there is no military solution.

title: Houthis fire missiles at Riyadh after Saudi-led strikes on Yemen port
caption: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted three ballistic missiles fired by Yemen's Houthis at Riyadh early on Saturday, a day after Saudi-led air strikes on Hodeidah port and Sanaa. The Houthis have warned airlines that Saudi airspace is unsafe and threatened Saudi Red Sea ports. The UN says it is deeply concerned about the escalation and that there is no military solution.
